title: go-fvm-sdk
tagline: go-fvm-sdk enables GO developers to write FVM contracts in TinyGo.
description:
More specifically, go-fvm-sdk compiles contracts written in GO into WASM executables. It has full compatibility with FVM system call interface,  unit/integration test support and allows native WASM actor deployment on FVM!

The project is part of the initiative of fvm.filecoin.io to support a diversified cohorts of developers to contribute to the greater Filecoin L2 ecossytem.
how_its_made:
Technology we used mainly involved WASM support of GO programming language. We are also making up stream contributions so that the language could better serve an even larger developer community who is building on top of these tools.

More details on README.md of https://github.com/ipfs-force-community/go-fvm-sdk
